{{Top|leg}}
An '''energy fence''', '''energy screen''', or '''power screen''' was a defensive security system. The fences projected walls of visible, deadly energy. An individual coming into contact with an energy fence was repulsed with a force equivalent to being struck by a bolt from a [[Heavy repeating blaster/Legends|heavy repeating blaster]]. Energy fences had a variety of settings and power ratings, ranging from low-power fences to military grades models. Energy fences could be bypassed by sufficiently powerful [[Individual field disruptor/Legends|individual field disruptors]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
